# Test fixtures

`projects/` is generated by `scripts/refresh-fixtures.sh` — never edit by hand.
Run the script inside the KiCad base image
(`ghcr.io/peterus/copperchat-kicad-base:<KICAD_COMMIT>`); it copies the demos
the image installed from the pinned KiCad commit (`/usr/share/kicad/demos`) and
records that commit in `projects/KICAD_COMMIT`.

| Fixture | Source (KiCad repo `demos/`) |
|---|---|
| `projects/ecc83/` | `ecc83/ecc83-pp.*`, `sym-lib-table`, `fp-lib-table`, `footprints.pretty/` (not `ecc83-pp_v2.*`: a second `.kicad_pro` in one directory makes the project ambiguous; not `3d_shapes/`) |
| `projects/complex_hierarchy/` | `complex_hierarchy/` (hierarchical sheets: one root, `ampli_ht.kicad_sch` instantiated twice) |
| `projects/blank/` | not a demo: `scripts/make-blank-fixture.py` (called by `refresh-fixtures.sh`) copies KiCad's `template/kicad.kicad_pro`, has a headless api-server create and save an empty `blank.kicad_sch` + `blank.kicad_pcb`, and copies the ecc83 project library (`ecc83-pp.kicad_sym`, `sym-lib-table`) verbatim |

`reference/` holds single files written by eeschema at the pinned commit, compared as
text by tests (never opened as projects); also made by `scripts/refresh-fixtures.sh`:

| Fixture | Source (KiCad repo `demos/`) | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `reference/sheet_pins.kicad_sch` | `simulation/subsheets/mainsheet.kicad_sch` | how KiCad writes sheet pins on the left (`at … 180`, `justify left`) and right edge (`at … 0`, `justify right`) |

Files are copied verbatim and upgraded only with `kicad-cli sch upgrade --force` /
`kicad-cli pcb upgrade --force`; the `.kicad_prl` files kicad-cli writes while
upgrading are removed. License: the KiCad source repository
(https://gitlab.com/kicad/code/kicad) is GPL-3.0-or-later; these demo files are
redistributed under the same terms, compatible with CopperChat's GPL-3.0-only.

`golden/*.json` come from `scripts/regen-golden.py` (real api-server);
`golden/png/*.png` and `golden/board_snapshot.json` from `scripts/update-goldens.sh`;
`kicad-cli/*.json` are `kicad-cli sch erc` / `pcb drc --format json` outputs
recorded by `scripts/regen-golden.py`. All three scripts run inside the base image.

`repo_context.py` is not a fixture tree but a builder: `build_fixture_repo(tmp_path)`
writes a small project repository (README, `docs/spec.md`, an OpenSCAD enclosure, a
binary `.stl`, an `.env`, a symlink out of the repo, a nested KiCad project) and
commits it with `git init`; no `.git` is committed here (repo-context spec §9).
